# HaikaiTech Solutions

> HaikaiTech Solutions is a registered software engineering studio in Penang, Malaysia (SSM: 202603149868, CA0422517-K). We build business websites, custom web apps, dashboards, and interactive systems for clients worldwide — from one-time "Website Siap" packages to fully managed monthly plans and quotation-based custom software.

## Services

- [Services & Pricing](https://haikaitech.my/services/): Business websites (one-time from RM1,500 or RM199/month managed), company profile design, custom software, add-ons, and maintenance pricing.
- [Business Toolkit](https://haikaitech.my/toolkit/): Free tools for Malaysian SMEs — invoice generator, quotation builder, receipt maker, purchase order, and payroll calculator.

## Portfolio

- [AVS Bina](https://haikaitech.my/projects/avsbina/): Construction company website built with Astro and React.
- [Adyumrah Hajj & Umrah](https://haikaitech.my/projects/adyumrah/): Hajj & Umrah travel booking platform with admin dashboard.
- [Hawker Rewards](https://haikaitech.my/projects/hawkerrewards/): Loyalty rewards app for hawker stalls.
- [Clarity Learn Centre](https://haikaitech.my/projects/clarity-learncentre/): Learning centre website with course information.
- [Fuzzfloor](https://haikaitech.my/projects/fuzzfloor/): Premium editorial presentation site.
- [Murtajiz](https://haikaitech.my/projects/murtajiz/): Project case study.
